question: Who among the following has been conferred the Padma Vibhushan in 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sudarshan Sahoo**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sudarshan Sahoo, an eminent Indian sculptor known for his exceptional work in stone and wood, was conferred the **Padma Vibhushan** in **2021**.
 
• The Padma Vibhushan is the second-highest civilian award in India, recognizing exceptional and distinguished service in any field.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Keshubhai Patel**: A prominent Indian politician and former Chief Minister of Gujarat, Keshubhai Patel passed away in 2020, so he was not awarded in 2021.
 
• **Sumitra Mahajan**: A senior politician and former Speaker of the Lok Sabha, she has been influential in Indian politics, but she was not awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2021.
 
• **Jagdish Chaudhary**: There are no records of him being awarded the Padma Vibhushan in 2021.
